ai.question: How does Jiahua combine AI technology with professional tax services?
ai.answer: We utilize our proprietary AI platform for real-time policy searching and data matching across thousands of federal, state, and local programs—an extent impossible via manual effort. However, every official application submitted to government agencies is rigorously reviewed and processed by our experienced tax and accounting professionals. Our AI ensures comprehensiveness, while our experts ensure accuracy and compliance.

fees.question: What is Jiahua’s fee structure? Are there any hidden fees?
fees.answer: We operate on a low initial evaluation fee combined with a performance fee charged only upon approval or fund disbursement. All terms and fee details are explicitly outlined in our service agreements with zero hidden costs.

smallBusiness.question: My business is small or newly established. Are we still eligible for government grants or tax credits?
smallBusiness.answer: Absolutely! Numerous federal, state, and local programs are specifically designed to support small businesses, minority-owned enterprises, and startups. Eligibility is often based on specific criteria such as industry type, payroll, or qualified expenses, rather than company size alone. Our AI system efficiently identifies programs tailored to your specific situation.

applicationProcess.question: Is the application process complicated or time-consuming for business owners?
applicationProcess.answer: Not at all. We provide a full-service, turnkey solution. You only need to provide basic operational documents (such as tax returns or payroll reports) during the initial stage. Our team handles all subsequent steps, including policy matching, document drafting, submission, and government follow-ups, minimizing any disruption to your day-to-day operations.

applicationImpact.question: If an application is not approved, will it affect my company’s tax status or credit score?
applicationImpact.answer: Definitely not. All our advisory and filing processes strictly adhere to IRS guidelines and relevant federal and state regulations, thoroughly vetted by licensed CPAs. Applying for government incentive programs in full compliance with the law is a legitimate corporate right and will have zero negative impact on your routine tax filings or business credit profile.
